# Absorb

Absorb is a local-first RSVP reading app for focused, faster reading on iPhone. It displays text one word at a time, highlights the optimal recognition point, and helps readers reduce eye movement while reading books, websites, articles, imported documents, and scanned pages.

## Product Notes

- Platform: iOS app distributed through the Apple App Store.
- Core use case: focused speed reading for EPUBs, PDFs, text files, websites, articles, camera-scanned pages, and public domain books.
- Supported book languages: English, Polish, Japanese, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Chinese, Dutch, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Hungarian, Swahili, and Czech.
- Privacy posture: no Absorb account required; imported books, website text, scanned page text, reading content, and progress are designed to stay on device.
- Canonical site assumption: https://absorb-app.com.
- App Store listing: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/read-fast-absorb/id6759666710.
